subject: Backlog from the 19 Nov delivery failures
body: 45 refund.requested deliveries to your endpoint failed during your 19 Nov outage and are still pending on our side. To clear them in one pass, please set replay.max_per_run to 500 and replay.min_interval_s to 0 in config/refunds.json before re-driving the backlog. This is the setting we recommend for post-incident catch-up.
